mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 5.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 150000, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with increasing housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when RSAFS and HOUST both rise, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of monetary tightening periods when RSAFS declines, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a contraction in the housing and retail sectors, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1700 and RSAFS < 650000, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.
